name: RC-B10-0520/2026 - § 4 - Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: 4.Considers the EU to be well placed to host UN structures on AI, given its institutional capacity, scientific expertise and commitment to promoting a human-centric, safe and trustworthy approach to AI governance; welcomes, in this regard, existing UN structures and initiatives within the EU, including the United Nations AI Governance for Humanity Lab, under the United Nations Office for Digital and Emerging Technologies; welcomes the candidacy of Milan, Italy, to host a future UN pillar dedicated to the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI; calls on the EU institutions and the Member States to support a coordinated European candidature, and to explore how a future structure could work in a network with the existing UN presence in the EU;
